formalization.project_name: The Colbourn–Dinitz–Rosa conjecture and the exact block-type spectrum
formalization.review_status: self-assessed; local verification passed; not submitted to Palomar

mathematical_sources.note: The mathematical results were developed alongside their Lean proofs. The two accompanying preprints describe these results. CDR 1999 proposed the class-size conjecture and supplied earlier constructions.
mathematical_sources.title: The CDR class-size characterization and exact block-type spectrum

mathematical_sources.note: Accompanying Paper II, Theorem 1. The written proof invokes CDR 1999 Theorem 2.6 for the last finite cases. The formal proof verifies explicit tables instead. This submission replaces the archived native checks by kernel reduction on natural-number tables without changing the theorem.
mathematical_sources.title: A proof of the Colbourn–Dinitz–Rosa conjecture

mathematical_sources.note: Accompanying Paper I, Theorem 1; the threshold is existential.
mathematical_sources.title: The exact block-type spectrum in the Colbourn–Dinitz–Rosa problem

mathematical_sources.note: The spectrum proof uses the formalized theorems T and T+.
